bottleneck.description: Leading maker of the highest-complexity FC-BGA / ABF IC package substrates that carry the largest AI accelerators and data-centre CPUs; ABF substrate is a named frontier choke-point.

editorial.notes: Ibiden holds the majority of the top tier of organic package substrates, the very high-layer-count, large-body parts the biggest AI GPU packages require, a segment that is sold out. Competitors exist (Shinko, Unimicron, AT&S, Samsung Electro-Mechanics, Nan Ya) but are described as roughly a generation behind at that leading edge, and Ibiden secures close to all orders for the high-end generative-AI server substrates against demand-constrained supply, so customers cannot route around it there. It rates HIGH, short of CRITICAL only because alternatives are being qualified. The substrate is built on Ajinomoto build-up film upstream, itself an even tighter choke-point with Ajinomoto supplying the large majority of that film; the automotive-ceramics segment does not dilute the rating, which attaches to the substrate business that provides the majority of both sales and profit.
